address: 4575 North Leaf River Rd, Mount Morris, IL 61054

feeding_claim.verbatim: our 100% grass-fed beef, pork, and lamb are nurtured on our multi-generational family farm

notes: Dietrich family farm near Mount Morris in northern Illinois, owned by the family since 1947. Checked the homepage, about, products and contact pages. Cattle (mostly Black Angus and Devon) are rotated daily onto fresh grass paddocks and fed hay in winter; the about page says the pigs are supplemented with grain, so the homepage line calling the pork grass-fed is not taken at face value. Category kept at grass-fed because the farm's own pages do not clearly say grass-finished, although the Barn2Door store description says grass-fed/grass-finished. Sales are through the farm's Barn2Door online store, which would not load here, so pickup, delivery, shipping and bulk options could not be confirmed. Farm visits are by appointment. No phone is published on the site.
